title: Papers, Please
notes: Official Linux 1.4.11.124, fresh English normal story profile; native 570x320 captured at 2x with normalized inputs. Read-only encrypted stash/daily-save scoring. Arrest, family-death and debt endings terminate an attempt. The researcher policy accepts successful escape regardless of accompanying family, EZIC revolution and cleared-to-continue-working endings. Recovery is unsupported. Once work begins, the clock and animations advance without input, so timing is real-time. Shared pidfd process pause passed native stop/resume, frame stability, an extended native-time trace and a day-three DAY-to-NIGHT operator acceptance with repeated freezes. Formal model frozen-Trial acceptance remains pending. The language model uses two attempts within 21,600 seconds; Jev uses one attempt within 7,200 seconds.
introduction: Papers, Please is a document inspection simulation played through consecutive workdays. You operate a border checkpoint, examine travelers and their documents, and make admission decisions through the visible interface. Workdays have a running clock, and the story can conclude in different endings. This run begins in the first workday office with a fresh English normal-difficulty story profile and no travelers processed.
controls: Use the mouse to click visible interface controls and to drag documents and other movable objects between screen positions. The left mouse button selects, presses, picks up and releases objects. Consult the visible game interface for available controls.
